title: Using CloudTrail LookupEvents to Identify the Source of Lambda Rate Exceeded Errors
description: Use AWS CloudTrail LookupEvents to identify which IAM identity or service is triggering 'Rate exceeded' throttling errors on Lambda management API calls.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: You might receive a 'Rate exceeded' error when your environment exceeds Lambda function quota limits for API requests. Before you can resolve a 'Rate exceeded' error, review your CloudTrail event logs using the following commands

snippets.title: View the total count of management event API calls
snippets.description: Run the CloudTrail lookup-events AWS CLI command. Set the start-time, the end-time, and the time zone for each value to match the problematic timeframe.

snippets.title: View the total count of API calls made by each user
snippets.description: Run the CloudTrail lookup-events command. Set the start-time, the end-time, and the time zone for each value to match the problematic timeframe.
